test_policy.notes: The international undergraduate page lists only a 2.3 GPA (4.0 scale) and English proficiency for freshmen; no SAT/ACT is listed for international applicants (SAT EBRW 550 or ACT English+Reading 21 can substitute for an English test). The domestic freshman checklist does require official ACT/SAT scores (automatic admission: 3.00 GPA, or ACT superscore 19 / SAT superscore 990). Confirm in the International Admissions Tool whether your country needs scores.

requirements.notes: International application fee is $50 ($30 for domestic freshmen). Apply in the A-State portal as 'International Undergraduate'; submit documents through myDen. Freshmen need a 2.3 GPA on a 4.0 scale; transcripts must be translated into English. Official documents are only required after admission, on arrival. A decision is promised within 24-48 business hours of a complete file. Some programs (nursing, engineering, business) add a college support fee.

deadlines.label: International application deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Application, fee and all documents are due by this date; orientation Aug 9, 2027, classes start Aug 18, 2027. Spring 2028 deadline is Nov 1, 2027. Domestic freshman admission has no closing date (CDS C14).

english_policy.waiver_notes: No test needed for citizens of Anguilla, Antigua & Barbuda, Australia, Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Bermuda, British Virgin Islands, Canada (except Quebec), Cayman Islands, Dominica, Falkland Islands, Ghana, Gibraltar, Grenada, Guyana, Ireland, Jamaica, Liberia, Montserrat, New Zealand, Nigeria, Saint Helena, South Africa, St. Kitts & Nevis, St. Lucia, Trinidad & Tobago, Turks & Caicos, United Kingdom, Zambia, Zimbabwe. Other accepted proof: SAT EBRW 550, ACT English and Reading 21, IB English A or B HL 5-7, iTEP Academic Plus 3.5, EIKEN Grade Pre-1, completion of A-State's ESL program (80%) or a CEA/HOFT program, English marks of 60% (India, Nepal, Pakistan) or 75% (Kenya), or two years at a US/UK/Canada/Australia/NZ high school. Scores must be less than 2 years old; A-State's ESL program is available on campus for students who need it.

english.notes: The at-home TOEFL iBT is accepted. The page does not give a 1-6 band minimum, so TOEFL_IBT_2026 is not listed. ETS code 6011.

aid.notes: A-State's international freshman scholarship is $3,000 per year (also $3,000 for transfers with 24+ hours); it requires full admission, a 3.25 GPA and English proficiency, and cannot be combined with other scholarships. International students are not eligible for federal aid; CDS H6 reports only non-need-based institutional aid for nonresidents (693 recipients, average $6,435).

sat.note: A-State's international pages give no SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: A-State's international pages give no ACT code; look it up at act.org.
